import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import './CSS/Home.css';

function Home({ onSelectProduct }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const scrollRef1 = useRef(null);
  const scrollRef2 = useRef(null);
  const scrollRef3 = useRef(null);

  const [wishlistItems, setWishlistItems] = useState([]);
  const [showWishlistDropdown, setShowWishlistDropdown] = useState(false);

  // Load wishlist items on mount & listen for updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchWishlist = () => {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wishlistItems')) || [];
      setWishlistItems(saved);
    };

    fetchWishlist();
    window.addEventListener('wishlistUpdated', fetchWishlist);
    window.addEventListener('storage', fetchWishlist);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('wishlistUpdated', fetchWishlist);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', fetchWishlist);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleRemoveFromWishlist = (id, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const updated = wishlistItems.filter(item => (item._id || item.id) !== id);
    setWishlistItems(updated);
    localStorage.setItem('wishlistItems', JSON.stringify(updated));
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('wishlistUpdated'));
  };

  // Top Picks products with extensive, detailed information
  const topPicks = [
    { 
      id: 1, 
      category: 'KITCHEN • PIGEON',
      title: 'Pigeon Amaze Plus Electric Kettle', 
      price: '$499', 
      originalPrice: '$1,245', 
      rating: '4.0', 
      reviews: '179,344', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1546868871-7041f2a55e12?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1546868871-7041f2a55e12?w=500',
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1585515320310-259814833e62?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Pigeon Amaze Plus 1.5 Litre Electric Kettle with robust stainless steel body, rapid boiling heating element, classic ergonomic handle, and advanced multi-level safety protection systems engineered for modern kitchen environments.',
      keyFeatures: [
        '1.5 Litre capacity ideal for fast water boiling, instant noodles, and tea preparation for the entire family.',
        'Concealed stainless steel heating element engineered for enhanced durability, prevention of mineral scale build-up, and effortless cleaning.',
        'Automatic shut-off feature combined with dry-boil protection prevents accidental electrical hazards and overheating accidents.',
        '360-degree swivel power base for seamless cordless lifting, convenient right or left-handed pouring, and clutter-free countertop storage.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 2, 
      category: 'DINING • CLAZKIT',
      title: 'Clazkit Water Bottle Stainless Steel', 
      price: '$159', 
      originalPrice: '$299', 
      rating: '4.0', 
      reviews: '2,383', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Clazkit premium insulated water bottle built with heavy-duty food-grade steel, scratch-resistant finish, and leak-proof sealing ring designed to maintain beverage temperature and freshness throughout active daily schedules.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Manufactured using premium food-grade 304 stainless steel ensuring zero metallic taste transfer and complete rust resistance.',
        'Advanced leak-proof cap mechanism featuring a tight silicone sealing ring to prevent accidental liquid spills in bags.',
        'Sweat-free outer powder-coated texturing ensures a firm, non-slip dry grip during high-intensity gym workouts or outdoor jogs.',
        'Eco-friendly and reusable construction engineered to eliminate single-use plastic waste for long-term sustainable daily hydration.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 3, 
      category: 'KITCHEN • GNASTAS',
      title: 'GNASTAS Kitchen Utility Knife', 
      price: '$709', 
      originalPrice: '$1,499', 
      rating: '4.3', 
      reviews: '101', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593618998160-e34014e67546?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593618998160-e34014e67546?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'GNASTAS professional-grade kitchen utility knife featuring precision-forged high-carbon steel, tapered cutting edge, balanced bolster, and custom-molded comfort grip handle for culinary precision.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'High-carbon stainless steel blade retains a razor-sharp cutting edge significantly longer than conventional kitchen knives.',
        'Ergonomically engineered handle minimizes hand strain and wrist fatigue during lengthy meal preparation sessions.',
        'Corrosion and rust-resistant polished blade finish ensures pristine hygiene and effortless food release.',
        'Versatile utility sizing handles everything from delicate fruit peeling to precise vegetable dicing and meat trimming.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 4, 
      category: 'APPLIANCES • PIGEON',
      title: 'Pigeon Kessel Multipurpose Kettle', 
      price: '$949', 
      originalPrice: '$1,695', 
      rating: '3.8', 
      reviews: '30,147', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1585515320310-259814833e62?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1585515320310-259814833e62?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Pigeon Kessel Multipurpose Kettle offering multi-functional cooking capabilities including boiling, steaming, and simmering with an extra-wide mouth design and adjustable thermal control settings.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Extra-wide mouth opening enables effortless food insertion, stirring, and deep cleaning after heavy cooking tasks.',
        'Variable temperature knob control allows tailored heating adjustments for boiling water, cooking noodles, or preparing hot soups.',
        'Sturdy transparent glass lid lets you visually monitor cooking status without releasing accumulated steam and heat.',
        'Built-in dry-boil thermal protection mechanism automatically cuts off power if liquid levels deplete entirely.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 5, 
      category: 'APPLIANCES • AMAZON BASICS',
      title: 'Amazon Basics Electric Egg Boiler', 
      price: '$429', 
      originalPrice: '$650', 
      rating: '4.1', 
      reviews: '13,391', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1584269600464-37b1b58a9fe7?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1584269600464-37b1b58a9fe7?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Amazon Basics compact and rapid electric egg boiler designed to cook up to seven eggs simultaneously across soft, medium, or hard consistency levels with automatic thermal shut-off.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Simultaneously boils up to 7 eggs efficiently, saving valuable breakfast preparation time.',
        'Offers 3 customizable texture firmness modes (soft, medium, hard) governed by exact water measurement levels.',
        'Automatic thermal shut-off protection triggers immediately when the steaming cycle completes and water evaporates.',
        'Includes a graduated utility measuring cup equipped with an integrated shell-piercing pin to prevent cracking.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 6, 
      category: 'HOME • AERYS',
      title: 'AERYS Digital Alarm Clock with LED', 
      price: '$284', 
      originalPrice: '$1,999', 
      rating: '3.9', 
      reviews: '7,947', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1563861826100-9cb868fdbe1c?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1563861826100-9cb868fdbe1c?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'AERYS modern digital LED alarm clock featuring high-contrast numeric display, dual alarm memory, multi-stage brightness control, and convenient USB power integration.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Large, high-contrast LED display provides crystal-clear numeric readability from across dark bedrooms.',
        'Multi-stage adjustable screen brightness levels prevent nighttime glare while ensuring daytime legibility.',
        'Convenient snooze function offers customizable wake-up time extensions with a simple tap.',
        'Reliable USB-powered configuration backed by internal memory preservation during power interruptions.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 7, 
      category: 'ELECTRONICS • NOISE',
      title: 'Noise Buds VS104 Truly Wireless', 
      price: '$999', 
      originalPrice: '$2,999', 
      rating: '4.2', 
      reviews: '45,210', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1590658268037-6bf12165a8df?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1590658268037-6bf12165a8df?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Noise Buds VS104 True Wireless Earbuds equipped with advanced acoustic drivers, rapid InstaCharge technology, IPX5 water resistance, and intuitive touch controls for seamless audio immersion.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'InstaCharge rapid charging technology delivers hours of uninterrupted audio playback from a brief charge.',
        'Custom-tuned dynamic drivers produce punchy, crystal-clear acoustic output with enhanced deep bass delivery.',
        'IPX5 sweat and water resistance rating safeguards against heavy perspiration during rigorous workout routines.',
        'Smart capacitive touch controls manage music track skipping, call answering, and voice assistants easily.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 8, 
      category: 'TRAVEL • MILTON',
      title: 'Milton Thermosteel Flip Lid Flask', 
      price: '$675', 
      originalPrice: '$999', 
      rating: '4.5', 
      reviews: '12,500', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Milton Thermosteel Flask featuring double-wall vacuum insulation technology, one-touch flip-lid mechanism, and rugged exterior casing designed to preserve beverage temperatures for 24 hours.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Advanced double-wall vacuum insulation technology retains hot or cold liquid temperatures effectively for 24 hours.',
        'Convenient one-touch flip lid mechanism allows effortless one-handed drinking while traveling or driving.',
        '100% leak-proof threaded construction prevents messy liquid spills inside backpacks and briefcases.',
        'Sleek, streamlined profile fits comfortably into standard vehicle cup holders and side storage pouches.'
      ]
    }
  ];

  // Browsing History products with extensive, detailed information
  const browsingHistory = [
    { 
      id: 101, 
      category: 'ELECTRONICS • APPLE',
      title: 'iPhone Pro Max (2 TB) - Silver', 
      price: '$3,29,900', 
      rating: '4.5', 
      reviews: '15', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511707171634-5f897ff02aa9?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511707171634-5f897ff02aa9?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Apple iPhone Pro Max with massive 2 TB storage capacity, revolutionary A18 Pro processing architecture, professional 48MP triple-lens camera system, and aerospace titanium finish.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Powered by the ultra-fast A18 Pro chip designed for hardware-accelerated ray tracing and next-gen gaming.',
        'Professional 48MP fusion camera system featuring expansive optical zoom range and cinematic video recording.',
        'Aerospace-grade titanium chassis combining extreme structural durability with lightweight feel.',
        'Industry-leading battery optimization supporting all-day continuous high-performance media consumption.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 102, 
      category: 'FASHION • SONISHA',
      title: 'SONISHA Women Floral Print Short Kurti', 
      price: '$440.82', 
      originalPrice: '$1,799', 
      rating: '4.0', 
      reviews: '14', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583391733956-3750e0ff4e8b?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583391733956-3750e0ff4e8b?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'SONISHA ethnic short kurti crafted from 100% breathable cotton fabric with vibrant floral prints, tailored stitching, and skin-friendly texture designed for casual everyday styling.',
      keyFeatures: [
        '100% pure breathable cotton fabric ensures supreme airflow and all-day wearing comfort.',
        'Vibrant, fade-resistant floral print adds an elegant, contemporary ethnic touch.',
        'Skin-friendly organic material prevents skin irritation during hot summer weather.',
        'Easy machine washable construction requires minimal garment maintenance and ironing.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 103, 
      category: 'HOME • STORY@HOME',
      title: 'Story@Home King Size Bedsheet', 
      price: '$849.00', 
      originalPrice: '$999', 
      rating: '4.2', 
      reviews: '33', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1522771739844-6a9f6d5f14af?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1522771739844-6a9f6d5f14af?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Story@Home luxurious king-size bedsheet set made from ultra-soft brushed cotton fabric, complete with matching pillow covers and fade-resistant color pigments.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Generous king size dimensions cover large heavy mattresses securely with ample tuck-in fabric.',
        'Ultra-soft brushed cotton weave feels exceptionally gentle and cozy against the skin.',
        'Fade-resistant reactive dyes preserve rich color tones across repeated industrial washes.',
        'Includes two matching coordinated pillow covers for a uniform bedroom aesthetic.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 104, 
      category: 'ELECTRONICS • ACCESSORIES',
      title: '40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max', 
      price: '$4,490.00', 
      rating: '4.6', 
      reviews: '8', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583863788434-e58a36330cf0?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583863788434-e58a36330cf0?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'High-speed dual-port dynamic power adapter featuring intelligent power distribution, high-wattage charging support, and comprehensive circuit protection for modern mobile devices.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'High-speed dual port setup charges smartphones and tablets concurrently without speed reduction.',
        'Smart power distribution chips dynamically optimize wattage delivery according to connected device requirements.',
        'Built-in surge, short-circuit, and over-temperature safety protection mechanisms prevent hardware damage.',
        'Compact foldable prong layout maximizes portability for frequent business travelers.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 105, 
      category: 'AUDIO • JBL',
      title: 'JBL Go 3 Portable Wireless Speaker', 
      price: '$2,999.00', 
      originalPrice: '$3,999', 
      rating: '4.6', 
      reviews: '18,400', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1545454675-3531b543be5d?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1545454675-3531b543be5d?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'JBL Go 3 ultra-portable waterproof wireless speaker delivering surprisingly rich JBL Pro Sound, rugged fabric styling, integrated loop, and stable Bluetooth 5.1 streaming.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'IP67 waterproof and dustproof rating ensures resilience during beach trips and poolside lounging.',
        'Delivers surprisingly heavy JBL Pro Sound and punchy bass despite its ultra-compact enclosure.',
        'Integrated carrying loop lets you clip the speaker easily to backpacks, belt loops, or handlebars.',
        'Reliable Bluetooth 5.1 wireless streaming offering up to 5 hours of continuous playback per charge.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 106, 
      category: 'COMPUTING • LOGITECH',
      title: 'Logitech Wireless Mouse M220', 
      price: '$695.00', 
      originalPrice: '$995', 
      rating: '4.4', 
      reviews: '32,100', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1615663245857-ac93bb7c39e7?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1615663245857-ac93bb7c39e7?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Logitech M220 Silent Wireless Mouse featuring advanced optical tracking, noise-reduction click mechanics, long battery lifespan, and comfortable ambidextrous contouring.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Silent clicking technology eliminates over 90 percent of click noise for a quiet workspace.',
        'Energy-efficient circuit design delivers up to 18 months of battery life on a single battery.',
        'Tiny plug-and-forget USB nano receiver provides a stable, lag-free wireless connection.',
        'Ambidextrous contour shape ensures natural, fatigue-free hand positioning for hours.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 107, 
      category: 'MOBILE • JETECH',
      title: 'JETech Matte Case for iPhone Pro', 
      price: '$1,299.00', 
      originalPrice: '$2,099', 
      rating: '4.4', 
      reviews: '10,014', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601784551446-20c9e07cdbdb?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601784551446-20c9e07cdbdb?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'JETech translucent matte protective case engineered with shockproof TPU bumpers, anti-fingerprint coating, and precise cutouts tailored for iPhone Pro models.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Translucent matte finish exhibits the original phone Apple logo and design subtly.',
        'Advanced anti-fingerprint nano coating keeps the back panel clean, dry, and smudge-free.',
        'Reinforced shockproof bumper corners absorb impact force during accidental drops.',
        'Fully compatible with standard wireless charging pads without requiring case removal.'
      ]
    }
  ];

  // Related Items products with extensive, detailed information
  const relatedItems = [
    { 
      id: 201, 
      category: 'AUDIO • BOAT',
      title: 'boAt Rockerz 450 Bluetooth Headphones', 
      price: '$1,499', 
      originalPrice: '$3,990', 
      rating: '4.2', 
      reviews: '85,420', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740420928-5e560c06d30e?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740420928-5e560c06d30e?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'boAt Rockerz 450 On-Ear Wireless Headphones featuring immersive HD acoustics, 40mm drivers, plush ear cushions, and dual wireless/wired connectivity modes.',
      keyFeatures: [
        '40mm dynamic drivers produce high-definition balanced audio output with deep bass response.',
        'Plush padded ear cushions provide long-lasting comfort during extended listening sessions.',
        'Up to 15 hours of continuous battery playback on a single rapid charge cycle.',
        'Dual-mode connectivity supports both wireless Bluetooth streaming and traditional AUX cables.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 202, 
      category: 'WEARABLES • FIRE-BOLTT',
      title: 'Fire-Boltt Phoenix Smart Watch', 
      price: '$1,199', 
      originalPrice: '$9,999', 
      rating: '4.1', 
      reviews: '42,150', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523275335684-37898b6baf30?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523275335684-37898b6baf30?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Fire-Boltt Phoenix Smartwatch featuring crystal-clear Bluetooth calling, comprehensive health monitors, 120+ sports modes, and vibrant HD touch display.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Built-in high-sensitivity microphone and speaker enable crystal-clear Bluetooth calling from the wrist.',
        'Real-time health monitoring tracks blood oxygen SpO2, continuous heart rate, and sleep quality.',
        'Supports over 120 specialized sports modes for comprehensive athletic and fitness tracking.',
        'Vibrant high-definition touch display housed in a sleek metallic frame with custom watch faces.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 203, 
      category: 'FITNESS • BOLDFIT',
      title: 'Boldfit Yoga Mat with Carrying Strap', 
      price: '$699', 
      originalPrice: '$1,499', 
      rating: '4.3', 
      reviews: '11,400', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601925260368-ae2f83cf8b7f?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601925260368-ae2f83cf8b7f?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Boldfit Anti-Slip Yoga Mat providing optimal joint cushioning, textured grip surface, tear-resistant durability, and convenient over-the-shoulder carrying strap.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Dual-sided anti-slip texture provides superior traction to prevent slipping during yoga poses.',
        'Optimized thickness cushions knees, elbows, and spine against hard flooring surfaces.',
        'Tear-resistant material guarantees long-lasting fitness durability under heavy usage.',
        'Lightweight structure includes a convenient over-the-shoulder carrying strap for transit.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 204, 
      category: 'ACCESSORIES • PORTRONICS',
      title: 'Portronics Adapto 20W Fast Charger', 
      price: '$349', 
      originalPrice: '$999', 
      rating: '4.1', 
      reviews: '9,820', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583863788434-e58a36330cf0?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583863788434-e58a36330cf0?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Portronics Adapto 20W Wall Charger with Power Delivery fast-charging technology, smart IC protection chip, and fire-retardant compact body.',
      keyFeatures: [
        '20W Power Delivery output accelerates mobile device charging speeds significantly.',
        'Smart IC chip protects connected devices from voltage fluctuations and overcharging.',
        'Universal compatibility works seamlessly with smartphones, tablets, and wireless cases.',
        'Fire-retardant exterior casing ensures maximum electrical safety during operation.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 205, 
      category: 'AUDIO • ZEBRONICS',
      title: 'ZEBRONICS Zeb-County Bluetooth Speaker', 
      price: '$469', 
      originalPrice: '$799', 
      rating: '4.0', 
      reviews: '19,830', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1545454675-3531b543be5d?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1545454675-3531b543be5d?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'ZEBRONICS Zeb-County Portable Wireless Speaker supporting Bluetooth streaming, USB flash drives, Micro SD cards, and built-in FM radio with clear sound output.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Multi-connectivity supports wireless Bluetooth, USB drives, and Micro SD memory cards.',
        'Built-in FM radio receiver lets you tune into local radio channels on the go.',
        'Compact, lightweight form factor featuring a secure built-in carrying handle.',
        'Integrated call function allows hands-free telephone conversations directly through the speaker.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 206, 
      category: 'DINING • MILTON',
      title: 'Milton Go Fit Steel Bottle 750ml', 
      price: '$499', 
      originalPrice: '$650', 
      rating: '4.5', 
      reviews: '5,120', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1602143407151-7111542de6e8?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Milton Go Fit Single-Wall Steel Bottle with 750ml capacity, ergonomic grip body, leak-proof cap, and food-grade rust-free stainless steel construction.',
      keyFeatures: [
        '750ml generous fluid capacity fulfills daily hydration goals efficiently.',
        'Single-wall lightweight steel construction keeps total weight down for carrying.',
        'Leak-proof screw cap prevents accidental water spills inside athletic bags.',
        'Food-safe, rust-free stainless steel material guarantees pure, untainted water taste.'
      ]
    },
    { 
      id: 207, 
      category: 'COMPUTING • ZEBRONICS',
      title: 'Zebronics Zeb-Solaris Wireless Mouse', 
      price: '$399', 
      originalPrice: '$749', 
      rating: '4.0', 
      reviews: '4,150', 
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1615663245857-ac93bb7c39e7?w=500',
      images: [
        'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1615663245857-ac93bb7c39e7?w=500'
      ],
      description: 'Zebronics Zeb-Solaris ergonomic wireless optical mouse featuring high-precision tracking, plug-and-play USB nano receiver, and intelligent power-saving sleep modes.',
      keyFeatures: [
        'Ergonomic contour design reduces hand strain during extended computer work.',
        'High-precision optical sensor tracks smoothly on diverse desktop surfaces.',
        'Plug-and-play wireless nano USB receiver with stable, interference-free connection.',
        'Intelligent power-saving sleep mode preserves battery capacity during periods of inactivity.'
      ]
    }
  ];

  const renderProductRow = (title, items, ref, pageInfo, darkTheme = false) => (
    <div className={`product-row-wrapper ${darkTheme ? 'dark-theme' : 'light-theme'}`}>
      <div className="product-row-header">
        <div className="product-header-left">
          <h2 className={`product-row-title ${darkTheme ? 'dark-title' : 'light-title'}`}>{title}</h2>
          <Link to="/products" className="explore-link">Explore more deals</Link>
        </div>
        {pageInfo && <span className="page-info-text">{pageInfo}</span>}
      </div>

      <div ref={ref} className="products-scroll-box">
        {items.map((product) => (
          <div 
            key={product.id} 
            className="product-card-item"
            onClick={() => onSelectProduct && onSelectProduct(product)}
            style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <div className="product-image-box">
              <img src={product.image} alt={product.title} className="product-img" />
            </div>
            <p className="product-card-title">{product.title}</p>
            <div className="product-rating-box">
              <span className="product-stars">★★★★☆</span>
              <span className="product-reviews">{product.reviews}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="product-price-container">
              <span className="product-price-current">{product.price}</span>
              {product.originalPrice && <span className="product-price-original">{product.originalPrice}</span>}
            </div>
            <p className="product-delivery-text">FREE delivery <b>Thu, 1 Oct</b></p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="home-page-container" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
      
      {/* Top Wishlist Quick-Access Header Bar / Icon Container */}
      <div style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '15px',
        right: '25px',
        zIndex: 100,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '20px'
      }}>
        <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          {showWishlistDropdown && (
            <div style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              right: 0,
              top: '52px',
              width: '320px',
              backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
              border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
              zIndex: 1000,
              padding: '16px',
              color: '#0f172a'
            }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '12px', borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9', paddingBottom: '8px' }}>
                <h4 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '16px', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>My Wishlist ({wishlistItems.length})</h4>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setShowWishlistDropdown(false)}
                  style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', fontSize: '16px', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#64748b' }}
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </div>

              {wishlistItems.length === 0 ? (
                <p style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#64748b', fontSize: '14px', margin: '20px 0' }}>Your wishlist is empty.</p>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ maxHeight: '250px', overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
                  {wishlistItems.map((item) => (
                    <div 
                      key={item._id || item.id} 
                      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', padding: '6px', borderRadius: '8px', background: '#f8fafc' }}
                    >
                      <img 
                        src={item.image || item.images?.[0]} 
                        alt={item.title || item.name} 
                        style={{ width: '45px', height: '45px', objectFit: 'contain', borderRadius: '6px', background: '#fff' }} 
                      />
                      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: '600', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
                          {item.title || item.name}
                        </p>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#6366f1', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{item.price}</span>
                      </div>
                      <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleRemoveFromWishlist(item._id || item.id, e)}
                        style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#ef4444', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '14px', padding: '4px' }}
                        title="Remove"
                      >
                        <i className="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowWishlistDropdown(false);
                  navigate('/wishlist');
                }}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  marginTop: '12px',
                  backgroundColor: '#130352',
                  color: '#fff',
                  border: 'none',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  padding: '8px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  fontSize: '13px',
                  cursor: 'pointer'
                }}
              >
                View Full Wishlist Page
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Promotional Banner with Image */}
      <div className="home-hero-banner-box">
        <div className="hero-banner-content">
          <span className="hero-badge-tag">Sale is live</span>
          <h1 className="hero-main-title">Starting $49</h1>
          <h2 className="hero-sub-title">Home, kitchen, toys & outdoors</h2>
          <Link to="/products" className="hero-return-btn">
            Return to all deals
          </Link>
        </div>

        {/* Banner Image Box */}
        <div className="hero-banner-img-box">
          <img 
            src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526170375885-4d8ecf77b99f?w=600" 
            alt="Promotion Banner" 
            className="hero-banner-img"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 1. Top Picks Section (Dark Theme) */}
      {renderProductRow("Top picks", topPicks, scrollRef1, null, true)}

      {/* 2. Inspired by your browsing history Section */}
      {renderProductRow("Inspired by your browsing history", browsingHistory, scrollRef2, "Page 1 of 6", false)}

      {/* 3. Middle Offer Banner */}
      <div className="middle-promo-banner">
        <div>
          <span className="promo-badge">Limited Time Deal</span>
          <h2 className="promo-title">Up to 60% off | Electronics & Accessories</h2>
          <p className="promo-description">Explore top brands with no cost EMI and exchange offers.</p>
        </div>
        <Link to="/products" className="promo-shop-btn">
          Shop Now
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Related to items you viewed Section */}
      {renderProductRow("Related to items you viewed", relatedItems, scrollRef3, "Page 1 of 6", false)}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Home;
